verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped, delegated access for authorized third parties such as law firms, HRIS vendors, or wealth managers. Nothing shows OAuth grants, scoped API tokens, or limited-permission roles for external parties. The HRIS integration (docs-21/22) syncs employee data and terminations into AngelList rather than granting a vendor scoped access to equity data. Excel and OCF exports are manual data sharing, not delegated access, so both are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
